tools.name: product_info
tools.description: Look up a Sky High rental product by name. Returns the page URL, units in stock, how many times families have booked it, and price. ALWAYS pass event_date (and zip when you know it) - with a date this returns the EXACT price for that date and whether it is available, which you should quote directly.

tools.name: build_quote
tools.description: Build a complete, real quote for one rental on a specific date and delivery zip: exact dated item price, availability, delivery fee, that date's minimum order, the total, and the booking link. Use this the moment you know the product, the date and the zip - it is the fastest way to answer 'how much?

tools.name: delivery_fee
tools.description: Look up the delivery fee and minimum order for a Texas delivery zip code. Use when a customer asks what delivery costs or what the minimum order is for their area. tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add one rental to a real Sky High cart for a party date, delivery ZIP and hours, and get back a cart_id. Call build_quote first if the customer has not seen the price. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "product_info" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
